messages:
Alex R.: Heads-up — AcmeCorp reporting repeated declines on subscription renewal (attempts at 2024-11-01T14:02:23Z, 14:05:01Z, 14:18:10Z). Gateway returns `card_declined` with decline_reason `avs_mismatch` and `authentication_required` on the 3rd attempt. Last4 provided: 4312.

Maya S.: Do we have the raw gateway payload? Need AVS/CVV result codes and the BIN to check issuer rules.

Alex R.: Pasting redacted payload from Stripe webhook (PII removed):
```
{
  "id": "ch_1Jxyz...",
  "status": "failed",
  "failure_message": "Your card's address does not match your bank's records",
  "outcome": {"type":"issuer_decline","seller_message":"The bank declined the charge","network_status":"declined_by_network"},
  "avs_result": "N",
  "cvc_result": "U",
  "three_d_secure": "required",
  "card": {"brand":"visa","last4":"4312","exp_month":"09","exp_year":"2026","country":"US","bin":"411111"}
}
```

Ravi K.: @Alex R. thanks. AVS=N (no match), CVC=U (unavailable/unchecked) — that lines up with the gateway text. BIN 411111 is a US issuer that has tightened AVS rules recently.

Ravi K.: Two things to rule out: (1) Is the billing address format normalized? Small formatting diffs often trigger AVS=N. (2) Was there a 3DS challenge presented and failed or timed out? The payload shows `three_d_secure: required` — likely the issuer wanted authentication and the customer didn't complete it.

Alex R.: Customer says they entered the company PO box as billing address — AcmeCorp billing is PO Box 420. Could that cause AVS failures?

Maya S.: Yes — many issuers treat PO Boxes as non-matching for AVS when the cardholder address is a street. Also if the bank expects uppercase/no punctuation. We should ask the customer to try the street address registered with the bank or complete 3DS when prompted.

Clara T.: Customer is on an auto-renew subscription due today reneweal_id=sub_9a7. They are asking for immediate access — is it safe to do a manual override charge?

Ravi K.: Short answer: don't auto-force a bypass. If the bank required 3DS, forcing card on file without auth risks a true decline and chargeback. Options: (A) ask customer to retry with correct address + complete 3DS, (B) try alternate card, (C) as a one-off only if finance signs off and we accept chargeback risk.

Alex R.: I ran a manual API attempt (stripe.charges.create) with the same token — response is immediate `authentication_required`. Logged: `payment_intent last_payment_error: {type: card_error, message: 'Authentication required by card issuer'}`.

payments-bot: Automated note — recent merchant-level policy update: we now surface `authentication_required` to customers and block auto-retries after 3 failed attempts. See internal policy doc: /docs/payments/3ds-policy.

Maya S.: For troubleshooting: collect (a) full normalized billing_address sent in the API call, (b) the customer-reported address, (c) the browser/user-agent and flow (did they see a 3DS challenge), (d) whether tokenization used `setup_future_usage` on initial save.

Alex R.: Collected: billing_address we sent: `{"line1":"PO Box 420","city":"Burlington","state":"MA","postal_code":"01803","country":"US"}`. Customer insists bank has `100 Market St` as their card registration.

Ravi K.: That mismatch explains AVS=N. Also 3DS required — if the card is enrolled in ACS, issuer will block until challenge completes. Recommend asking customer to retry with the street address and follow 3DS prompt. If they cannot, ask for alternate payment.

Clara T.: Customer requested we attempt a temporary grace to restore services while they sort payment. Finance: @finance-bot can we authorize a 48-hour grace for subscription sub_9a7 if customer provides alternate payment or confirms they will retry?

finance-bot: Policy: Team can grant one 48-hour grace for first-time legitimate billing failures after verifying account status and no prior churn flags. Please escalate to Billing Ops with the account link and note ACME is enterprise trial.

Alex R.: Escalating to Billing Ops now. In parallel, @Ravi K. can you check if we have any fraud flags on the account (velocity, BIN mismatch, recent chargebacks)?

Ravi K.: Quick check: no prior chargebacks, low velocity (3 attempts only), no high-risk geo mismatch (account country US, card country US). Fraud signals low -> supports manual grace if finance approves.

Maya S.: Also add a note about 3DS UX. If they never saw a challenge it could be blocked by an iframe blocker or an old browser. Ask them to disable extensions or try incognito.

Alex R.: Update to customer message I'm about to send: short script: "We saw AVS mismatch — please retry using the street address on file with your bank and complete the 3D Secure prompt, or provide an alternate card. We can grant a one-time 48-hour grace pending finance approval." Any edits?

Clara T.: Add: "If you prefer, we can have our billing ops initiate a secure payment link that supports 3DS and shows the challenge. Reply if you'd like that."

Alex R.: Perfect. Sending now. I'll drop the Billing Ops ticket #BILL-448 and tag here once created.

(30m later)

Alex R.: Billing Ops created BILL-448. Finance approved 48-hour grace. Customer accepted to retry with street address and completed 3DS successfully at 2024-11-01T14:49:15Z. Charge succeeded.

Maya S.: Great follow-through — note for runbook: when AVS=N + three_d_secure=required we should default to requesting customer retry with bank-registered street and provide secure 3DS payment link, rather than immediate manual charge. I'll add to payments FAQ. :memo:

Ravi K.: Adding this transaction to the monitoring set so we can watch for similar BIN issuer behavior for the next 7 days.

Alex R.: Closing thread. Marking resolved in support queue and tagging the subscription for follow-up billing email to customer confirming renewal and how to update card on file. :white_check_mark:
